left-pad.name: left-pad
left-pad.readme:
## left-pad

String left pad

[![Build Status][travis-image]][travis-url]

## Install

```bash
$ npm install left-pad
```

## Usage

```js
const leftPad = require('left-pad')

leftPad('foo', 5)
// => "  foo"

leftPad('foobar', 6)
// => "foobar"

leftPad(1, 2, '0')
// => "01"

leftPad(17, 5, 0)
// => "00017"
```
